svg.title: Homeish dashboard look options
svg.desc: Sample mockups: the same admin dashboard in the current calm look, calm with small colour accents, and a colourful card-heavy style like the Multi School ERP demo.
svg.text: How much colour? Same dashboard, three looks
Sample mockups for discussion · not built · same numbers in every option
The page is mostly big boxes, each filled with a different bright colour, with a huge number in each and many coloured buttons below. It is what the
Multi School ERP dashboard does. Calm means a white page with thin outlines, where colour is used only to signal status (paid, overdue) or the one main
White page, thin outlines. Colour only for status
- Easy to read in sunlight and for older residents
- Can feel plain or "generic" at first glance
Like AcadLynk: a greeting, quick buttons, and a
small tinted icon on each tile.
- Warmer and less "generic" without losing clarity
- Quick buttons put common jobs one tap away
- DESIGN.md needs a small rule change to allow
Big solid-colour boxes, huge numbers, rows of
- Eye-catching in a demo or sales screenshot
- Colour stops meaning anything: is green "paid"
- Harder in sunlight and for older residents
Option B, full version: quick-action tiles and a graph
Yes, both fit. Tiles use one blue tint (not a rainbow); the graph is grey with this month in blue.
Tue, 24 Nov 2026 · Green Park Society · 3 things need you today
The quick-action tiles show the same list as the "+" button, so you set them up once; each person can pin their own. The dashboard has one small graph; the full charts
stay on Analytics, one click away. The greeting buttons from the small sample above are dropped, because the tiles replace them.
